metadata.name: marjan
metadata.description: Marjan: verifiable legal limits and single-financing control for public procurement obligations

accounts.name: fiscal_document
docs: Derived from the document key hash: a document can back only one obligation.

accounts.name: creditor
docs: The creditor (supplier) must consent to the assignment.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front-run the
initialization of a fresh deployment.

accounts.name: source_request
docs: Optional: the executed adhesion this obligation derives from. Writable,
because it tracks how much has been obligated against it (audit M-2).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent and fees. May be a sponsor: the agency signer needs no SOL.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The new authority signs too, so the root of trust can never be handed to
a key nobody controls.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: AgencyInactive
errors.msg: Agency is not active in the registry

errors.name: AccountMismatch
errors.msg: Supplied account does not belong to this record

errors.name: InvalidQuantity
errors.msg: Quantity must be greater than zero

errors.name: ExceedsIndividualCap
errors.msg: Art. 86 §4: adhesion would exceed 50% of the registered quantity for this agency

errors.name: ExceedsGlobalCap
errors.msg: Art. 86 §5: adhesions would exceed twice the registered quantity of this item

errors.name: FederalAdhesionForbidden
errors.msg: Art. 86 §8: federal agencies cannot adhere to state, district or municipal price records

errors.name: AtaNotInForce
errors.msg: Price record is not in force at this time

errors.name: ManagerCannotAdhere
errors.msg: The managing agency cannot adhere to its own price record

errors.name: InvalidRequestStatus
errors.msg: Adhesion request is not in the required status

errors.name: InvalidValidity
errors.msg: Invalid validity window

errors.name: AtaNotActive
errors.msg: Price record is suspended or cancelled

errors.name: AdhesionsNotAllowed
errors.msg: The tender does not allow adhesions to this item

errors.name: ExceptionNotApplicable
errors.msg: The claimed exception to the art. 86 §5 cap does not apply

errors.name: InvalidMaxAdhesion
errors.msg: Maximum quantity for adhesions cannot exceed twice the registered quantity

errors.name: ExecutionDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: Decree 11.462/2023 art. 31 §2: the execution deadline has passed

errors.name: ExecutionDeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: The execution deadline has not passed yet

errors.name: InvalidDeadline
errors.msg: Invalid execution deadline

errors.name: MunicipalAdhesionForbidden
errors.msg: Alagoas Decree 95.019/2023 art. 33: state agencies cannot adhere to municipal records other than those of state capitals

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ExceedsVerifiedAmount
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the verified (liquidated) amount of the obligation

errors.name: ExceedsDocumentedAmount
errors.msg: Eligible amount cannot exceed the amount backed by attached fiscal documents

errors.name: EligibilityBelowFinanced
errors.msg: Eligible amount cannot be set below the amount already financed

errors.name: ExceedsFinanceableBalance
errors.msg: Financing would exceed the obligation's remaining financeable balance

errors.name: ObligationNotFinanceable
errors.msg: Obligation is not open for financing in its current status

errors.name: ExceedsOutstanding
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the obligation's outstanding balance

errors.name: MissingEvidence
errors.msg: Evidence hash is required

errors.name: SourceAdhesionNotEffective
errors.msg: Source adhesion has not been executed

errors.name: SourceAdhesionMismatch
errors.msg: Source adhesion does not match this debtor or creditor

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NameTooLong
errors.msg: Agency name is longer than 64 bytes

errors.name: ExceedsAdhesionValue
errors.msg: Obligations citing this adhesion would exceed its authorized value

errors.name: NotClosable
errors.msg: Only terminal records can be closed

errors.name: OpenFinancings
errors.msg: Close every financing of this obligation first

errors.name: ResponseWindowOpen
errors.msg: The response window of this pending request has not passed yet

types.name: AccountClosed
docs: kind: 0 = adhesion request, 1 = financing, 2 = obligation.

types.name: AdhesionException
docs: Exception to the §5 cap claimed by an adhesion (Decree 11.462/2023, art. 32).

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Hash of the request (justification of advantage, price compatibility,
and, for exceptions, the supporting evidence).

fields.name: decision_evidence_hash
docs: Hash of the manager's justification (required for partial authorization or denial).

fields.name: execution_evidence_hash
docs: Hash of the contract or commitment note that executed the adhesion.

fields.name: unit_price
docs: Unit price copied from the item when the request is made.

fields.name: obligated_amount
docs: Total verified amount of obligations that cite this adhesion as their source.
Never exceeds `authorized_qty * unit_price`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Account that paid the rent; receives it back when the request is closed.

fields.name: is_health_ministry
docs: Attested by the registry: relevant to the health-emergency exception

fields.name: is_state_capital
docs: Attested by the registry: the municipality is a state capital
(Alagoas Decree 95.019/2023, art. 33).

fields.name: profile
docs: Regulation that governs this agency when it adheres to a record.

types.name: AgencyAttributes
docs: A public agency recognized by the registry. `authority` is the wallet that
signs on its behalf (in production, a multisig).
Facts about an agency attested by the registry issuer when it is registered.

types.name: AgencyItemUsage
docs: Quantity a given agency has committed (pending + authorized) on an item (§4).

types.name: Ata
docs: A price-registration record (Ata de Registro de Preços).

fields.name: supplier
docs: Wallet of the registered supplier, who must accept each adhesion.

fields.name: ata_id
docs: Hash of the canonical identifier (e.g. the PNCP control number).

fields.name: doc_hash
docs: Hash of the published record document.

types.name: AtaItem
docs: One item of a price record. `registered_qty` is immutable once created:
there is deliberately no instruction to increase it (Decree art. 23).

fields.name: registered_qty
docs: Quantity registered for the managing and participating agencies.

fields.name: max_adhesion_qty
docs: Maximum quantity the tender allows for non-participants (Decree art. 15, XI).
Zero means the tender does not allow adhesions.

fields.name: unit_price
docs: Unit price in integer cents.

fields.name: committed_capped
docs: Pending + authorized quantity of adhesions subject to the §5 cap.

fields.name: committed_exempt
docs: Pending + authorized quantity of adhesions under a statutory exception.

fields.name: authorized_total
docs: Quantity authorized by the manager (informational; includes exempt).

types.name: AtaStatus
docs: Status of a price record. Suspension models a supplier sanction during which
no new contracts may derive from the record (Decree 11.462/2023, art. 28, §1);
cancellation models arts. 28-29.

fields.name: notice_evidence_hash
docs: Hash of the evidence that the debtor was notified of the assignment.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Account that paid the rent; receives it back when the financing is closed.

types.name: FiscalDocument
docs: A fiscal document (e.g. NF-e) bound to exactly one obligation. Its address is
derived from the hash of the document key, so the same document cannot be
attached to a second obligation inside the protocol.

fields.name: obligation_id
docs: Hash of the canonical administrative identifier (e.g. managing unit + commitment number + fiscal year).

fields.name: source_request
docs: Adhesion this obligation derives from, or the default key if none.

fields.name: open_financings
docs: Financing accounts not yet closed; the obligation closes only at zero.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Account that paid the rent; receives it back when the obligation is closed.

types.name: Registry
docs: Singleton configuration. In the MVP the registry authority is a clearly
labeled demo issuer standing in for a real credential issuer (for example an
audit court or a state government using the Solana Attestation Service).

fields.name: eligibility_verifier
docs: Signer allowed to confirm that an obligation is eligible for assignment.

types.name: RegistryKeyChanged
docs: role: 0 = registry authority, 1 = eligibility verifier.

types.name: RequestStatus
docs: Lifecycle of an adhesion, in the order required by Decree 11.462/2023,
art. 31, §1: the manager authorizes only after the supplier accepts.

types.name: RuleProfile
docs: Which procurement regulation governs an agency's own conduct as an adherent.
Law 14.133/2021 applies to everyone; each sphere regulates art. 86 for itself.

types.name: Sphere
docs: Level of government an agency belongs to (relevant to Law 14.133/2021, art. 86, §8).
